title: docs(agents): a force-push is governed by the landing repo's AGENTS.md (objectui#9666)
body:
Fixes #9666

Clause-②: no — `AGENTS.md` is an agent-facing convention, not a published contract, accept set or public surface

## What this does

Implements ruling **C** on objectui#9666 (maintainer, 2026-09-18, Ruling-ref comment `5724939229`): neither force-push text changes, and objectui's root `AGENTS.md` gains **one sentence** saying that a force-push is governed by the `AGENTS.md` of the repository the branch lives in. The sentence is appended to the existing absolute ban bullet (the one opening with 「绝不 `git push --force`/`--force-with-lease`,绝不推 `main`」) in 「多 agent 协作纪律」, in that section's Chinese voice:

> **force-push 归分支所在的那个仓(landing repo)的 `AGENTS.md` 管**(objectui#9666,维护者裁决 C,评论 5724939229):objectui(即本条)与 cloud 一律绝对禁止,`../objectstack` 在它以 `Never force-push a *shared* branch` 开头那条的五项条件全部成立时允许 `--force-with-lease` —— 这三仓读数取自裁决当日,本仓没有任何东西复核它(诫条 #9),所以**跨仓工作的席位在给 dev 下指令之前,先读落地仓自己那条的原文**。

One file, one line changed (`AGENTS.md`, +1/-1 as git counts it: the sentence is appended to an existing single-line bullet). No other edit.

### Placement — stated because the ruling names a section this file does not have

The ruling places the sentence in objectui `AGENTS.md`'s 「cross-repo section」. No heading in the file is a cross-repo section (the headings were enumerated on the branch base); the only heading naming a sibling is 「服务纪律(本仓库与 `../objectstack` 多 agent 并行开发)」, which is about dev servers. The sentence therefore sits **beside the absolute ban it qualifies**, at the end of that bullet, inside the multi-agent section that already carries the other cross-repo rules (the verify lock living in `../objectstack`, the model-free trailer pair shared with `../objectstack`).

### How the sentence obeys this file's own commandments

- **#11 (cite by content):** objectstack's rule is cited by its opening words `Never force-push a *shared* branch`, not by a line address; `pnpm check:new-line-citations` reports 0 added citations.
- **#9 (a verified claim points at its instrument):** the three-repo reading (objectui and cloud forbid, objectstack allows under five criteria) is re-derived by nothing in this repository, and the sentence says so in its own text, then sends the seat to the landing repo's original — which is the ruling's own instruction.
- The English term `landing repo` is kept in parentheses so the premise query that found zero before this change (`git grep -n -iE "landing repo|the branch lives in" -- AGENTS.md`) now finds the sentence.

## Premise, re-measured on the branch base `06a96e9480`

- `git grep -n -iE "landing repo|the branch lives in" 06a96e9480 -- AGENTS.md` ⇒ 0 hits (exit 1); control `git grep -n -e "--force-with-lease"` on the same tree ⇒ 1 hit (the ban bullet). After this commit the first query answers 1.
- objectstack `origin/main` (`7dc45eb9`): the Multi-agent working discipline rule opening 「Never force-push a *shared* branch」 still states the five criteria ① `claude/issue-*` name ② this worktree created it ③ nobody else pushed ④ no reviewer/approval on its PR ⑤ explicit `--force-with-lease=BRANCH:SHA` — matches the sentence.
- The objectstack half of the ruling is already on objectstack `main`: `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` carries 「force-push 按落地仓 AGENTS.md:objectui/cloud 绝对禁;objectstack §3 五条全立才 `--force-with-lease`」.
- The card's first half (the trailer vector) landed with objectui#9441 (PR objectui#10922, `af2221d4`). This PR is the remaining half, and with it the card is complete.

## Acceptance notes

- **cloud's text is NOT MEASURED by this PR.** `objectstack-ai/cloud` is not reachable from this session (REST answers 403, repository access not enabled). The sentence's 「cloud 一律绝对禁止」 carries the ruling's own reading of cloud's `AGENTS.md`, and the sentence marks the whole three-repo reading as un-re-derived.
- ⛔ Governed surface (`AGENTS.md`, Tier H): this PR stays DRAFT. It is not flipped ready, not enqueued and not armed for auto-merge by the implementing agent; landing waits for an APPROVED review by an authorized approver and is then done by the claiming seat.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

- **改了什么**:在 objectui 根 `AGENTS.md`「多 agent 协作纪律」里那条「绝不 force-push」的末尾加了一句话:force-push 归分支所在仓的 `AGENTS.md` 管 —— objectui 与 cloud 绝对禁止,objectstack 在五项条件全部成立时允许 `--force-with-lease`;跨仓工作的席位给 dev 下指令前,先读落地仓自己的那条。只改这一处。
- **为什么改**:执行您 9 月 18 日对本卡的裁决 C。此前 objectui 的 PM 席带着 objectstack 的放行规则,指示 dev 在 objectui 分支上改写并强推,全靠 dev 拒绝才没丢历史。这句话把「看哪个仓的规则」写在席位会读的地方。
- **风险与代价(含回滚)**:纯文字,不影响任何代码、构建或发布。句中对三个仓的转述是裁决当天的读数,兄弟仓以后若改规则,这句转述会过时 —— 句子里已写明「以落地仓原文为准」。回滚就是 revert 这一个 commit。
- **席位意见**:
- **你要做的**:读一下新增的这一句,同意就在本 PR 上留一条 APPROVED review;之后由认领席负责入队落地。
